name: Nyíregyháza2022 ITS planning groups from actual map

properties.name: Belső lakóterület (Belváros)

controlPoints.method: Affine image-municipality-outline fit to actual municipal OSM boundary in EPSG23700

reviewNotes: One polygon follows each actual source numbered color region. Does not divide the25 nested quarter names by proximity.
Region masks use sampled source fill colors, RGB distance<48,3pixel closing, and original pixel-cell boundary tracing.
Thin source outlines and map text create at least3pixel boundary uncertainty; gaps between source outlines are retained.
Source2022 planning group boundaries and source map reuse rights need review before production assignment.
